source.code:
/-- A type is said to be infinite if it is not finite. Note that `Infinite α` is equivalent to
`IsEmpty (Fintype α)` or `IsEmpty (Finite α)`. -/
class Infinite (α : Sort*) : Prop where
  /-- assertion that `α` is `¬Finite` -/
  not_finite : ¬Finite α
